title: Night of Glory – IBSC Student Association
alt: IBSC Student Association members celebrating their recognition at Night of Glory
intro: Celebrating cross-cultural service and the students behind “We Are The World: Unity in Diversity.”
paragraphs: The IBSC Student Association celebrated a national student club activity award at Night of Glory on June 17, 2026. The recognition honored “We Are The World: Unity in Diversity,” a service project that brought local and international students together across languages and cultures.

Students contributed their time, energy, and commitment to a shared effort. The project’s success reflected their willingness to work through cultural differences and turn a diverse group into a united community.

The association also acknowledged the university’s Extracurricular Activities Section for its guidance throughout the project and the club’s development. Teachers supported students with practical advice and encouragement as they prepared to present their work.

The celebration looked ahead as well as back. By passing their experience to the next generation of members, students aim to keep the association’s spirit of cross-cultural service active within the IBSC community.
headline: Night of Glory: a celebration of the IBSC community
teaser: Celebrating student achievement and cross-cultural service through “We Are The World: Unity in Diversity.”
facts: Project: We Are The World: Unity in Diversity
contentNote: The official source describes a national student club activity award. This is recognition of a student activity, not an academic university ranking.
